title: Ignition Probability and SFT Convergence
summary: Combines the ensemble-convergence case delay-distribution check with Figure 5.14: the sampled SFT delay quantile must converge to the prescribed 10 s model time scale, while ensemble-mean ROS must respond consistently to Pign,small across resolution.
expected: The time-averaged leading-edge ROS normalized by Uwind should increase monotonically with Pign,small and should show weak sensitivity to dx = 5, 10, 20, and 30 m. The Pign,small = 0 limit approaches zero spotting-driven spread, while Pign,small = 1 approaches Uwind.
acceptance: All 200 response members and all 10 SFT-delay members must produce usable output. Response means must be monotone within uncertainty, cross-resolution spread must be <=0.10, and every Pign,small=1 mean must be >=0.90. The pooled SFT ensemble must contain at least 1000 actual ignition-delay samples; its 90th percentile must be within 1 s of 10 s and its bootstrap 95% half-width must be <=1 s.
